classDiagram
    %% Contract tokens: #include <cstddef>, std::size_t, #include "Collision.h", #include <cmath>, std::sqrt
    namespace breakout {
        class Vector2 {
            +double x
            +double y
            +Vector2()
            +Vector2(double x, double y)
            +Vector2 operator+(Vector2) const
            +Vector2 operator-(Vector2) const
            +Vector2 operator*(double) const
        }
        class Playfield {
            +double width
            +double height
            +Playfield(double w, double h)
            +double left() const
            +double right() const
            +double top() const
            +double bottom() const
        }
        class Ball {
            +Vector2 position
            +Vector2 velocity
            +double radius
            +Ball(Vector2 p, Vector2 v, double r)
            +void integrate(double dt)
        }
        class Paddle {
            +Vector2 position
            +double width
            +double height
            +void move(double dx, const Playfield& f)
            +double left() const
            +double right() const
            +double top() const
            +double bottom() const
        }
        class Brick {
            +Vector2 position
            +double width
            +double height
            +int durability
            +bool isAlive() const
            +void hit()
            +double left() const
            +double right() const
            +double top() const
            +double bottom() const
        }
        class Level {
            +vector<Brick> bricks
            +Level()
            +void generateGrid(int rows, int cols, Vector2 origin, Vector2 cellSize, int hp)
            +std::size_t remaining() const
        }
        class Collision {
            <<static>> +bool circleVsAABB(const Ball& b, double left, double right, double top, double bottom)
            <<static>> +Vector2 reflect(const Vector2& v, bool flipX, bool flipY)
        }
        class GameEngine {
            +Playfield field
            +Level level
            +Ball ball
            +Paddle paddle
            +int score
            +int lives
            +enum Input { Left, Right, None }
            +GameEngine(const Playfield&, const Level&, const Ball&, const Paddle&)
            +void step(double dt, Input input)
            +bool isLevelCleared() const
            +std::size_t remainingBricks() const
            +int getScore() const
            +int getLives() const
        }
        Level --> Brick
        GameEngine --> Level
        GameEngine --> Ball
        GameEngine --> Paddle
        GameEngine ..> Collision
        Ball --> Vector2
        Paddle --> Vector2
        Brick --> Vector2
        Playfield --> Vector2
    }
